title: HORIZONS — المرجع النظري المرافق
scope: Modern Standard Arabic for beginning readers; dialect variation explicitly labelled, not treated as error
principles: Original authored prose and examples; no copying textbook pages, tables, images or recordings without documented reuse rights.
Citations identify the specific claim they support. Naming a source is not itself permission to reproduce it.
Separate sources actually consulted from proposed bibliography; no invented page numbers or quotations.
Arabic targets remain Arabic in every translation. IPA is a stable phonetic aid; spelling-based approximations are labelled, never presented as exact equivalence.
A native-language bridge is optional; when no safe match is established, teach articulation rather than inventing a matching word.
All translations must retain examples, learning objectives and answer rationale and receive a per-locale review status.
Translation draft is not reviewed publication. No English fallback masquerading as a complete translated chapter.
No fixed page-count goal. Screen pagination and print pagination may differ.
Every print page carries author identity and approved contact email. Publication blocked until email is supplied.
Theory reading/quiz data is separate from authoritative workbook progress and entitlements.
Printed exercises include their answers in a separate answer section, not missing behind a collapsed interactive control.
